messages.subject: For Kim Fausing | Energy efficiency, government relations and international growth
messages.body:
Dear Danfoss Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Kim Fausing, President and Chief Executive Officer, where appropriate.

Danfoss operates where electrification, energy efficiency, industrial investment and public policy increasingly meet. Those priorities closely match my current executive responsibilities and my work around renewable-energy and regulated industrial operations.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across complex mining, infrastructure and energy matters.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of government relations, sustainability execution and emerging-market stakeholder leadership could support Danfoss internationally. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Danfoss.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
